pairingEvidence.source: Original Jelly_Operator1.22 offline port3101, character3, paused callbacks. Original startup matched all799 retained fixture keys. No fixture refresh.
pairingEvidence.observedBranches: Points115/115/0; all60 reachable; upgrade170 alone unpurchased; capped and uncapped upgrades; covered and uncovered effects; all specialized secondary rules; crowns25; Glimbo498 gives four complete blocks; Lore6/7 complete; Cooking Mastery unlocked; rawRift65 and companion87 active; all20 boats below400 despite purchased grant; five owned Shapes with zero rotation and 2/9/3/9/13 covered real upgrades;24 real upgrades uncovered; all20 saved placement tuples present, only ten static definitions apply; Doot description branch only. Original templates contain all six tokens { } $ ^ & |. Sixteen original templates use purchased-level token |. Earlier generated exports omitted those suffixes; the human restored them through the external WikiBot export on 2026-10-14.
pairingEvidence.unobservedBranches: Positive or negative available Points; negative or fractional purchased ranks; affordability with free Points; inaccessible real upgrades; purchased Grid positions at columns0/19; adjacency transition across a twenty-column row boundary; missing Shape placements; no owned Shapes; nonzero or negative rotations; rotation unlocked; maximum Shape ownership; geometric overlaps and all-source Shape obtainability; absent Sigil Lore; locked Cooking Mastery; individual Rift-only and companion-only unlocks; qualifying level400 boats; Doot token-only numerical branch and non-Doot runtime sentence. Both Divine sentences retain exact documentary checks; only Doot selection is runtime-observed. Purchased-level substitutions are observed in original descriptions. All60 static templates and populated descriptions passed paired original1.22 comparisons after the human-restored export on 2026-10-14.
pairingEvidence.numericBoundary: Configured tolerance0 with shared5e-7 baseline. Preserve getCompanionBonus(0) numeric Grid dependency. Description uses getCompanionActiveBonus(0)===1. Original helper0=1 observes only Doot branch.
pairingEvidence.descriptionParityGapStatus: Resolved historical gap: earlier generated descriptions omitted purchased-level suffixes at these sixteen indices. The human fixed the external WikiBot export and updated the repository on 2026-10-14. Passing resumed evidence in .ui-verification/research-p2-backend/resumed-verification.json and .ui-verification/runs/2026-10-14T08-37-32-341Z-2448/ confirms paired original1.22 comparisons for all60 static templates and populated descriptions. The retained indices identify the historical gap, not an active external prerequisite. Core tests retain separate parity assertions for every upgrade. The runtime scenario repeats these comparisons, retains exact original/website templates and descriptions for each failure, completes remaining backend/navigation checks, and fails at the end if any mismatch remains. No backend restoration or generated edit is needed. This evidence does not establish connected-release parity.
pairingEvidence.limits: Parent executes extraction and checks. Config author ran none. This pairing does not establish connected-release parity or rendered Part2 acceptance.

"Arctis_nods_in_approval..._all_Research_Grid_bonuses_are_1.05x_higher" : "You_are_now_permanently_linked_to_Arctis_on_all_characters."); return {index,text}; }).filter(entry=>squares[entry.index][0]!=="Name"); })()
